name: Theni
source: Theni District Survey and Land Records / Tamil Nadu Department of Survey and Settlement public land-record services

queries.query: Theni India official cadastral parcel map land records survey department
queries.result: Found the official Theni District Survey and Land Records page, official Theni land e-Services page, Tamil Nadu e-Services portal, TNGLMS, and Government of India DILRMP map-digitization status. The district page identifies the local Survey and Land Records office and links the state services; no public parcel API or bounded feature response was exposed by the indexed pages.

queries.query: தேனி மாவட்டம் நில அளவை வரைபடம் அரசு இணையதளம் பட்டா
queries.result: Tamil-language discovery returned the same first-party Theni District and Tamil Nadu land-record leads. It evidenced Tamil Nadu government land-record services and Theni survey administration, but did not reveal a separate public parcel API or a safe parcel feature response.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Theni District Administration, Assistant Director (Survey & Land Records)
officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Theni district; local survey and land-record administration
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: The official page states that land is surveyed through F-line and subdivision work, identifies the Assistant Director office at the Collectorate Building in Theni, and links state land-record systems. It says FMS computerization is complete, while village-map mosaicing remains in progress.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Theni District Administration / National Informatics Centre
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: The official service page lists View Patta & FMB / Chitta / TSLR Extract, A-Register Extract, Patta verification, and Poramboke verification; it names District Survey Office Theni and links the Tamil Nadu e-Services portal.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Commissionerate of Land Administration, Government of Tamil Nadu
officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Tamil Nadu land information system; not independently demonstrated as Theni parcel coverage
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: The official portal describes a phased land-information system linking RoR, cadastral maps/FMB and other systems, including a GLMS Landparcels module. The public page also displayed a login form; no login or private route was attempted.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Department of Land Resources, Government of India
officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: DILRMP progress report for Theni tehsil
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: The report lists digitized FMB/Tippan counts for Theni-area villages, including Theni Allinagaram with zero reported map sheets, and records maps as not georeferenced and not linked with ROR in the displayed status. This is program-status evidence, not a parcel API.
